title: First Light — the enclave in ninety seconds

steps.caption: This is a quantum computer that happens to look like a farm.
Every field is a density matrix. The sun and moon you see are one qubit's two poles.
An icon plants an axis — two atoms paired into north and south.
Hadamard. The qubit now holds both answers at once — watch the bubble split its light.
Measurement. Born's rule decided; the state collapsed; the improbable pays more — you just learned something, and learning is the economy.
Nothing here decays. Nothing leaks. The enclave holds — only measurement leaves a scar.
The reap: a season's worth of glances, paid in surprisal. E = −kT·log p.
